title: History Nature and Culture of Key West Walking Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This tour goes beyond the typical Key West history walk by connecting the island's people, cultures, architecture, plants & wildlife. Led by a passionate local guide, you'll discover how nature, history & community shaped Key West into the unique place it is today. With a small-group setting, you'll enjoy a personal experience filled with stories, insights & local knowledge that most visitors never hear.
